There are several cars and motorcycles driving down the street, as well as people walking on the sidewalk. The street is paved with asphalt and has yellow lines painted on it to indicate lanes and pedestrian crossings. There are also several planters with greenery along the sidewalk.

The street is relatively wide, with a few cars parked along the curb and a few more driving down the street.
